capabilities: Open branching which-key menus from a leader key
Edit the keymap as a tree or YAML/JSON
Navigate a radial dial on mobile
disambiguation: Not a Vim mode or keyboard-layout plugin; it adds leader-key menus, macros and a mobile dial.
extras: Ships with no default leader hotkey; the user must bind one. The mobile dial is only shown on phones and tablets.
problem: Remembering and finding individual hotkeys for many Obsidian commands and files is difficult.

relations.evidence: Neovim-inspired leader keys and sequential keybindings
